project_name: Character model sheet, 4 turnaround views showing front, back, three-quarters, and side profile in one image of Gianluca Moretti, 31-year-old charismatic Italian GT3 racing maestro. Handsome chiseled Mediterranean features, wavy styled dark brown hair with distinguished silver streaks at temples, neat designer stubble beard, smoldering amber-brown eyes, confident charming smile. Wearing a tailored royal cobalt-blue and liquid mirror-chrome racing suit with subtle Italian tricolor piping, white leather driving gloves, luxury racing boots. Holding a glossy royal blue helmet with aerodynamic chrome fin accents under his arm. Crisp cel-shaded anime style, thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, sharp geometric shadows, neutral grey studio background
